description: In server.rs route_method Mailbox/set, bump_state is called before delegating to handle_mailbox_set, so the state is always incremented regardless of whether the operation succeeded or any subscriptions actually changed. RFC 8620 §5.3 requires that oldState and newState differ only when a write actually occurred. A client doing Mailbox/get with sinceState=N will incorrectly receive a state mismatch on the next Mailbox/changes call if an operation returned notCreated for all entries, because newState > oldState even though nothing changed.
title: Mailbox/set state bumped unconditionally even when no group subscription changes
